topic: Distill waves 1-11 + env/seed arc into sm-bro-dispatch-patterns and the dogfood-orchestration prompt
notes:
Peeled from thread-36f3cced. The validated orchestration practices are scattered across thread notes; fold them into sm-bro-dispatch-patterns (code-owned system memory) and prompts/dogfood-orchestration.md so future orchestrators inherit them instead of re-deriving:

- SEQUENTIAL-VS-PARALLEL CALCULUS CHANGED: the "sequential dispatch for cargo-heavy waves" practice (wave 5/6 era) was motivated by cold-build serialization + host CPU saturation; with sccache-everywhere + seed_dirs, parallel worktree fan-outs no longer compile-storm. Re-state the rule as: parallel is fine when worktrees are seeded; the remaining serialization concern is fold-time, handled by orchestrator-sequenced closeouts (4/4 clean in wave 7).
- VALIDATION BUDGETS: full-lib gate is ~610s — briefs must set 900s+ cargo timeouts (w11 bro burned 3 reruns discovering this); check-only mid-flight, full gate end-only + at fold.
- bro_wait param is timeout_seconds (NOT timeout_secs) — pre-4dda50a this was silently dropped = unbounded wait; post-4dda50a all bro params reject unknown fields loudly, so treat unknown-field errors as spelling bugs, never retry verbatim.
- SKINNY-BROFILE LANE: skinny-brodex (provider_defaults=explicit_only + 2-sentence lens) measured at 1.65K fresh tokens/turn with zero quality loss on a well-specified brief — the recommended shape for mechanical implementation waves; rich lenses reserved for judgment-heavy work.
- PROVIDER LANE ECONOMICS (n=1-2 each, wave 7/11): brodex gpt-5.5 high = meticulous + code-mode-heavy; deepseek = chunky reads, self-recovering; minimax = slowest but best steer-compliance; glm = sharp API archaeology, one builtin-flail (since fixed).
- HYGIENE THAT PROVED ITSELF: orphan process-group reaping (bros now do it unprompted), exec-vs-resume continuity, bro_when_all over hand-rolled watchers, IDE-diagnostics as cross-worktree drift detector.

System-memory discipline applies: invariants and runbook guidance only, no wave chronology/ledger (sm convention 8b2ff028); the rendered fleet dispatch-env convention (c46b67e8) already covers the env/seed_dirs surface itself.

Resolved without distillation — the wave-11 learnings don't meet the system-memory bar (one-year test). Code-enforced invariants (timeout_seconds rejection, seed_dirs) are already the authority. Provider economics are transient (stale within weeks). Prompt-writing patterns (skinny brofile) belong in prompts/ if anywhere, not a system memory. What was genuinely runbook-shaped already landed in the existing sm-bro-dispatch-patterns through prior arcs.
